name: spook-explainable-condition-assessments
instr:
Give users a structured explanation whenever a Spook condition is evaluated, including the decision, stable outcome, readable summary, and JSON-serializable evidence. The same assessment capability must be available to direct callers, Home Assistant response services, condition watchers, and waits without changing established condition behavior.

Every assessment of the existing chance, cooldown, quota, triggered-by-user, not-triggered-by-user, triggered-by-automation, and repair-issue-present conditions must agree with an ordinary check performed from the same runtime inputs and evaluation snapshot. Chance evidence and its decision come from exactly one random draw, while cooldown and quota evidence preserves exact temporal cutoffs, current-run exclusion, and boundary-relevant durations or counts. User attribution distinguishes attributed, unattributed, unmatched, unlinked, and missing-person outcomes without disclosing unrelated context, while automation attribution traverses the complete source chain despite self, nearer mismatches, or configured filtering. Repair assessments deterministically summarize only currently active, nonignored issues satisfying the configured domain and severity filters, without retaining mutable prior evidence. Unknown, malformed, or unassessable configurations raise Home Assistant validation errors and cannot corrupt cached discovery or later evaluations.
